message: Astra: Within Ya na’s “Inner Monologued:”, what response does her repeated self-warning invite from the reader, and is that your intended response? Which detail deserves closer attention to judge the difference? What could further thinking settle that an informative revision would not, and what unresolved uncertainty makes drafting now less useful? What evidence would justify either choice? Could you briefly state your finding, uncertainty, and chosen next step in English, then carry out that choice?
speaker: Astra
